name: Ring of Kerry
description: The classic loop of the Iveragh Peninsula from Killarney: Ladies View, Moll's Gap and the coast past Waterville and Sneem

name: Slea Head Drive
description: Around the tip of the Dingle Peninsula: Atlantic cliffs, beehive huts and the Blasket Islands offshore

name: Conor Pass
description: Ireland's highest mountain pass, a narrow road over the Dingle Peninsula with lakes below; not for big vehicles

name: Gap of Dunloe
description: A narrow mountain pass between MacGillycuddy's Reeks and the Purple Mountain, past five lakes

name: Ring of Beara
description: The quieter, wilder neighbour of the Ring of Kerry, with the Healy Pass over the middle

name: Healy Pass
description: Hairpins over the Caha Mountains on the Beara Peninsula with views of Glanmore Lake

name: Wild Atlantic Way
description: The signed coastal route from Donegal to Cork: the Cliffs of Moher, Connemara, Achill and the peninsulas of Kerry

name: Connemara and the Sky Road
description: Bog, lakes and the Twelve Bens from Galway to Clifden, then the Sky Road's loop above the bay

name: The Burren
description: Limestone pavement country by the Atlantic, with the coast road past Black Head and the Corkscrew Hill

name: Inishowen 100
description: Around the Inishowen Peninsula to Malin Head, Ireland's northernmost point, and the Gap of Mamore

name: Wicklow Mountains (Military Road)
description: Over the Sally Gap and down to Glendalough, an hour from Dublin, through bog and mountain

name: Copper Coast
description: A UNESCO geopark coast of coves and old copper mines between Tramore and Dungarvan
